class.name: VoxelServer
class.brief_description: Low-level owner of all sparse signed distance field voxel data.
class.description: VoxelServer holds every voxel field in the engine behind an opaque [RID], in the same way that [RenderingServer] holds meshes and textures. It is the only place voxel data actually lives; every other voxel class is a handle to it. Most code should not use this class directly. Prefer the resource and node layers built on top of it, which manage the server's [RID]s automatically and integrate with the scene tree, the inspector, and resource saving.

method.name: get_field_count
method.description: Returns the number of voxel fields the server currently owns. Useful for leak checks, since a field that is never freed keeps its memory for the lifetime of the process.
